title: Cocartesian sections realize enhanced limits of transport diagrams
statement: Let $C$ be a small ordinary category, let $D$ be a strict functor from $C$ to small quasicategories, and let $q:Q\to N(C)$ be a cocartesian fibration of quasicategories, with $Q$ in the containing universe, together with a strict presentation $\varphi:G_C(D)\to Q$ of $q$ by $D$ [def-cbc-enhanced-cartesian-fibration]. Then evaluation on fibres, with the transport equivalences, exhibits $\Gamma_{\mathrm{cocart}}(N(C),Q)$ as the enhanced limit $\operatorname{holim}_{N(C)}D$ of the diagram $D:N(C)\to\mathrm{Cat}_\infty$, with limits and equivalences understood as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. In particular it is equivalent to the enhanced category of coherent compatible systems $x_c\in D(c)$ with equivalences $D(f)(x_c)\simeq x_d$ for every arrow $f:c\to d$, together with the compatibility data for every simplex of $N(C)$; the equivalence at $f$ attached to a cocartesian section $s$ compares the cocartesian edge $s(f)$ with the cocartesian edge $\varphi(f,s_0x_c)$, where $x_c\in D(c)$ corresponds to $s(c)$. Morphisms are coherent transformations of such systems and need not be equivalences. This is an equivalence of quasicategories on all mapping spaces and higher simplices, retaining the evaluations and transport equivalences. It is natural in two senses. For a functor $u:C'\to C$ of small categories, $\varphi$ pulls back to a strict presentation of $N(u)^*Q$ by $Du$, and restriction of cocartesian sections corresponds to restriction of the limit along $N(u)$. For a strict natural transformation $\eta:D\to D'$, a second such datum $(Q',\varphi')$ over $N(C)$ and a map $g:Q\to Q'$ over $N(C)$ preserving cocartesian edges with $g\varphi=\varphi'\circ G_C(\eta)$, where $G_C(\eta)(\sigma,\tau)=(\sigma,\eta_{\sigma(0)}\tau)$, the map of cocartesian sections induced by $g$ corresponds to the map of limits induced by $\eta$.

source.place: Proposition 7.4.4.1 (Tag 05RX) and Corollary 7.4.4.2 (Tag 02TK), limits as cocartesian sections of a cocartesian fibration with covariant transport representation (Definition 5.6.5.1, Tag 028V); comparison of strict diagrams with transport representations, Subsection 5.6.4 (Tag 0279). The strict presentation is a quasi-equivalence over each simplex in the sense of Lurie, Higher Topos Theory, Definition 3.2.2.6 and Proposition 3.2.2.7 (printed pp. 180-181), dualized.
